steps.bash: docker exec -i gg-postgres psql -U postgres -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='checklist'" | grep -q 1 || docker exec -i gg-postgres psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE checklist'
docker exec -i gg-postgres psql -U postgres -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='blocker'" | grep -q 1 || docker exec -i gg-postgres psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE blocker'
docker exec -i gg-postgres psql -U postgres -d checklist < examples/checklist/checklist/schema/checklist.postgres.sql
docker exec -i gg-postgres psql -U postgres -d blocker < examples/checklist/blocker/schema/blocker.postgres.sql
